seo.metaDescription: Browse our website development portfolio featuring fast, mobile-friendly websites built for Greenville and Upstate South Carolina businesses and beyond

blocks.richIntro:
**We're proud to showcase some of the businesses that have trusted Devin with their online presence over the years.**

With over 15 years of experience, Devin has built websites for businesses across a variety of industries, focusing on performance, user experience, and results. Every site is designed to attract customers, generate leads, and support your business goals.

**Explore some of our recent projects below.**

items.title: Dent Tech
items.richBody: Built a mobile-friendly website that clearly explains hail and dent repair services and makes it easy for customers to request estimates and get help with insurance.

items.title: Connecting Signs
items.richBody: For this client, who owned a commercial sign and vehicle wrap business, Devin created a well-organized website that clearly structures services, products, and project photos so customers can quickly find what they need and take the next step.

items.title: NorthStar Homes
items.richBody: Built a searchable home model database that helps prospective buyers easily explore floor plans and customization options that converts visitors from inspiration to inquiry.

items.title: Aggie Plumbing & Service
items.richBody: Built a responsive plumbing website that highlights local expertise and presents services in a clear, easy-to-browse structure across multiple service areas.

items.title: Epic Egg
items.richBody: Built a website for a growing restaurant group that makes it easy for customers to find locations, view menus, and order online.

items.title: BRD Vet RX
items.richBody: Built an order-driven website that makes it easy for customers to quickly purchase products and easily place repeat orders contributing to high-volume sales performance.

items.title: Flower Tribe
items.richBody: Built a beautiful, modern website that showcases floral arrangements and makes it easy for customers to place orders online.

items.title: Hunter Law, LLC
items.richBody: Developed a SEO-optimized law firm website with dedicated service pages, clear navigation, and strong calls-to-action that help turn visitors into clients.

items.title: Children Youth Community RI
items.richBody: Built a clear, content-rich website that organizes programs, leadership, and resources to communicate the organization’s mission, impact, and community work. Included a custom loading experience and built a flexible website structure that allows every section to be easily updated and maintained.

items.title: Double Yolker Kennels
items.richBody: Karen designed a content rich mobile-friendly website for Labrador Retriever Breeders that showcases available puppies, breeder expertise, and a clear step-by-step process for bringing home a new Labrador Retriever puppy.

items.title: Rex Verify
items.richBody: Devin developed a custom web-based verification platform that securely automates bank account balance verification and background checks, delivering professional, shareable reports for individuals and businesses.

items.title: Pride Mechanical
items.richBody: Designed a website that showcases Pride Mechanical's expertise in residential, commercial, and agricultural HVAC and plumbing services, including specialized solutions for dairy farms. Devin highlights the family-owned business story and builds trust with potential customers in the About section of the page.

blocks.body:
## Built for Businesses Like Yours

We have worked with a variety of local, regional, and national businesses over the years. From landscapers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, and contractors to home builders, attorneys, and restaurants, we understand what it takes to build a website that attracts customers and supports growth.

Whether you're a local service provider or a growing organization, we create websites that combine professional design, strong performance, and real business results. Whatever your industry, we're ready to help build a website that works as hard as you do.
